# Career Exploration

## **Overview**

The **Career Exploration** feature in the Career Scenario Simulator is designed to help users explore and find job opportunities based on their competency profiles. It provides an interactive visualization of job roles, allowing users to filter, label, and compare positions, understand job level distributions, and engage with a "Wizard" for deeper insights. This feature is ideal for trainees and professionals seeking to understand the job market and identify roles that match their skills and experience.

---

## **Feature Walkthrough**

1. WHY USE CAREER EXPLORATION?

* Instant insight into 100 \+ AI and data roles mapped directly to your competency profile.

* Interactive scatterplot exposes skill gaps and pivot paths visually.

* Built-in AI Wizard answers career questions and suggests concrete next steps.

![][image2]

---

2. THE MAIN SCREEN AT A GLANCE

Area labels  
 A – Scatterplot (each dot is a job; distance shows similarity to you)  
 B – Avatar (orange “A” represents your current profile)  
 C – Green dot(s) \= closest matching role(s)  
 D – Left panel \= details and similarity list for selected role  
 E – Wizard panel \= AI chat, opportunities, growth path

![][image3]  
---

3. BROWSING BY POSTING DATE

1. Click the date-range control at the top.

2. Pick a start and end date.

3. The job set refreshes instantly.

![][image4]

---

4. FILTERING BY FIELD

Choose between:  
 • All fields (default)  
 • Machine Learning & AI  
 • Data & Analytics  
 • Generative AI  
 • Others

 ![][image5]

---

5. TOGGLING ON-SCREEN LABELS

Available options: None, Title, Field, Level, Salary.

![][image6]![][image7]

---

6. BUBBLE SIZE \= SALARY

Switch Size → Salary to make higher-paying roles larger.

![][image8]  
---

7. YOUR AVATAR & CLOSEST MATCH

Hover your avatar (A) or any green dot to view skill-gap vectors.

![][image9]  
---

8. ROLE DEEP-DIVE

Click any dot. It turns red, the left panel fills with details, and a job-level distribution bar appears.

![][image10]  
---

9. ASKING THE WIZARD

After a role is selected the Wizard suggests prompts such as:  
 “How does this compare to similar roles?”  
 “What unique challenges make this role interesting?”  
 “Which uncommon skills give candidates an edge?”

![][image11]  
---

10. ONE-CLICK APPLY

The right-hand drawer shows company bio, location, salary, key responsibilities and an “Apply Now” button.

![][image12]

---

11. SELECTING MANY JOBS AT ONCE (MULTI-SELECT)

1. Toggle Multi-Select above the plot.

2. Drag a rectangle to pick several roles; count appears in red.

![][image13]  
---

12. KEYWORD SEARCH INSIDE THE PLOT

Type in the Search jobs bar; only matching titles remain visible and a result count is displayed.

![][image14]  
---

13. COMPARING A SENIOR-LEVEL MATCH

Example: Selecting “Machine Learning Ops (MLOps) Engineer” reveals very similar senior roles in the sidebar.

![][image15]  
---

14. DEEP QUESTIONS & RICH ANSWERS

Ask Wizard anything about the selected role—e.g., “What unconventional skills give candidates an edge?” Answers appear with full context.

![][image16]  
---

15. OPPORTUNITIES TAB

Switch to Opportunities for guidance on target companies, salary expectations and market outlook.

![][image17]  
---

16. GROWTH PATH TAB – SKILLS TO IMPROVE

Wizard pinpoints the competency offering the biggest return and sets a micro-goal.

![][image18]  
---

17. WHY THIS MATTERS & POTENTIAL IMPACT

Scroll farther for an explanation of the skill’s importance, an industry trend highlight and a salary-lift estimate.

![][image19]  
---

18. VISUAL PROGRESS TRACKER & LEARNING CHECKLIST

Left side: new roles unlocked after you gain the indicated % improvement.  
 Right side: practical projects, study blocks and practice drills you can check off.

![][image20]  
---

19. RE-ENGAGE VIA PREVIOUS CONVERSATIONS

Wizard stores all past queries so you can resume exactly where you left off.

![][image21]  
---

---

NEXT STEPS FOR TRAINEES

1. Experiment: try a 30-day window, then a 7-day window.

2. Ask Wizard: “Which course best closes my gap?”

3. Star three roles and share them with your mentor.
